tool.name: ParaFEM Post-Processor
tool.description: Package ParaFEM solver output into EnSight Gold format for ParaView
tool.command:
mkdir -p output && cp '$d_file' output/job.d && cp '$bnd_file' output/job.bnd && cp '$fix_file' output/job.fix && cd output &&
## Generate .ensi.geo from .d file using pf2ensi pf2ensi job 2>&1 &&
## Unpack solver EnSight output and add to the case directory cd .. && tar xzf '$ensi_tarball' -C output/ 2>/dev/null;
## Add NDPTL variable to .case file if present (steady-state p123) if ls output/job.ensi.NDPTL-* 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then echo -e "scalar per node:\t\tPotential\tjob.ensi.NDPTL-******" >> output/job.ensi.case fi &&
## Add NDTTR variable to .case file if present (transient p124) if ls output/job.ensi.NDTTR-* 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then NSTEPS=\$(ls output/job.ensi.NDTTR-* | wc -l) echo -e "scalar per node:\t1\tTemperature\tjob.ensi.NDTTR-******" >> output/job.ensi.case echo "TIME" >> output/job.ensi.case echo -e "time set:\t1" >> output/job.ensi.case echo -e "number of steps:\t\${NSTEPS}" >> output/job.ensi.case echo -e "filename start number:\t0" >> output/job.ensi.case echo -e "filename increment:\t1" >> output/job.ensi.case echo "time values:" >> output/job.ensi.case seq 0 \$(( NSTEPS - 1 )) | xargs printf "%10E " >> output/job.ensi.case fi &&
## Package everything cd output && tar czf ../ensi_package.tar.gz job.ensi.* && cd .. && mv ensi_package.tar.gz '$output_ensi' && cp output/job.ensi.case '$output_case'

param.name: ensi_tarball
param.label: Solver EnSight output (.tar.gz)
param.help: Tarball of .ensi.NDPTL-* or .ensi.NDTTR-* files from solver

data.name: output_ensi
data.label: EnSight Gold package (.tar.gz)
data.help: Complete EnSight Gold case for ParaView

tool.help:
Assembles ParaFEM solver output into a complete EnSight Gold case for ParaView.
Uses pf2ensi to generate the geometry (.ensi.geo) and case (.ensi.case) files from the mesh .d file, then adds the solver's scalar field output (NDPTL for steady-state potential, NDTTR for transient temperature).
Output is a tarball containing all .ensi.* files. Open the .ensi.case file in ParaView to visualize the results.
For steady-state (p123): scalar potential field For transient (p124): temperature field with time steps
